title: One Group, Not Two
goal: Black to play. The left half has one eye and nowhere to go. Settle it.
hint: White has a stone between the two halves, and it is standing on one liberty.
explanation: Two groups with one eye each are two dead groups. Joined, they are one group with two eyes and nothing White can do about it -- and the cutting stone came off the board on the way, which is what made the third eye.
